data.title: 卡莲 · 冬日雪街的热可可小憩
data.description: 白雪覆盖的商店街长椅旁，卡莲双手捧着热可可纸杯，在啜饮后停下脚步回头。短短的银白发梢露在毛线帽边，红色大衣挡住寒风；她的琥珀色眼眸在路灯下泛起一丝安宁的笑意。
data.location: 银装素裹、华灯初上的冬日商店街街角长椅
data.action: 啜饮后双手稳住纸杯，停在长椅旁回头微笑
data.lighting: 街边暖黄路灯与初雪反光的清冽微芒
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, peaceful winter street view
data.promptProse: She pauses beside the bench, cupping hot chocolate beneath her chin. Streetlight warms her face while snow reflects cool light onto her coat.
data.animaCaption: She pauses beside the bench with the hot-chocolate cup held beneath her chin.
